samples.text: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in plant cells. Chlorophyll absorbs primarily blue and red wavelengths. Oxygen is released when water molecules are split.
Newton's first law describes inertia when net force is zero. The second law relates force to mass times acceleration. The third law states that interaction forces are equal and opposite.
A relational database stores data in tables with defined schemas. Primary keys uniquely identify table rows. Foreign keys represent relationships between tables.
The water cycle includes evaporation, condensation, and precipitation. Solar energy drives evaporation from oceans and lakes. Condensation forms clouds when water vapor cools.
Supervised learning trains models with labeled examples. Classification predicts discrete categories. Regression predicts continuous numerical values.

Deoxyribonucleic acid carries hereditary information in living organisms. DNA contains the bases adenine, cytosine, guanine, and thymine. Complementary strands pair adenine with thymine and cytosine with guanine.
A compiler translates source code into another representation before execution. Lexical analysis groups characters into tokens. Syntax analysis checks whether tokens follow the language grammar.
Plate tectonics explains the motion of Earth's lithospheric plates. Divergent boundaries create new crust as plates separate. Convergent boundaries can produce subduction when plates collide.
